clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1.   Scope - Requirements for gate and shutter hooks and eyes which are commonly used on doors and windows for keeping them in position when kept open.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types Type 1- Mild steel and hard-drawn brass hooks and eyes, and Type 2- Cast brass hooks and plates.

clauses.title: Type 1– 65 (4.17),

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 4. Tolerances For length upto  size 250  ±  2   mm For length upto  size 300  ± 3    mm For average Diameter of ±  0.5     mm cast brass hooks

clauses.title: Finish – The articles
clauses.text: 5. Finish - The articles shall be finished bright. Note - For detailed dimensions and shapes, refer to Table 1 and 11, Fig.1 and 2 of the standard For detailed information, refer to IS 207 : 1964  Specification for  gate and shutter hooks and eyes (revised).
